hero.title:
Your operational processes,

automated with AI agents.
hero.subtitle: For firms that grew faster than their processes. We connect your tools, automate the repetitive work, and you recover hours to bill.

about.label: Process first
about.headline: The problem isn't missing tools —<highlight> it's that they don't talk to each other</highlight>
about.description: Your team becomes the glue between systems. We integrate what you already use and automate the repetitive work.
about.feature1Description: We start by understanding the real workflow — we don't sell generic software or agents for the sake of it.
about.feature2Description: We connect what you already use. If the process needs a new piece, we build it — not the other way around.
about.feature3Description: The first result arrives in 4–6 weeks: one concrete process running, not an endless project.
about.feature4Description: We don't sell a platform overhaul. Automate one workflow, measure the hours back, then tackle the next — same stack, no reset.

aiAgents.metaDescription: AI agents that understand your context, execute tasks across CRM, email, and billing, and keep professional services workflows moving without manual follow-ups.
aiAgents.heroSubtitle: Not chatbots for the sake of it — agents that read context, take action in the tools you already use, and leave an auditable trail of every step.
aiAgents.infoIntro: We design agent ecosystems around one concrete process first: a supervisor that decides what happens next, and specialized agents that execute each task with clear permissions.
aiAgents.feature1Desc: Agents pull from CRM records, email threads, spreadsheets, and billing — not generic prompts. They know <highlight>which client, which case, which deadline</highlight> before acting.
aiAgents.feature2Desc: Update a status, draft a follow-up, route a request, trigger an invoice. The agent <highlight>writes where your team would write</highlight>, with rules you define upfront.
aiAgents.feature3Desc: Every action is logged. Sensitive steps can require human approval. You always know <highlight>who did what and when</highlight> — including the agent.
aiAgents.deliverable1: Process map and agent architecture for one workflow
aiAgents.deliverable2: Supervisor + operational agents connected to your stack
aiAgents.deliverable3: Permission model and audit log for every action
aiAgents.deliverable4: Documentation and handoff session for your team
aiAgents.idealForDesc: A process depends on someone checking three systems, copying data, and sending follow-ups — and that person is the bottleneck.
aiAgents.timelineNote: First agent running on one process: typically 4–6 weeks.
aiAgents.ctaHeadline: Which process should an agent own first?
aiAgents.ctaText: Tell us the workflow nobody wants to inherit. We'll tell you if an agent is the right fit — or if something simpler works better.

automations.metaDescription: Workflow automations that eliminate copy-paste, manual follow-ups, and repetitive checks for professional services firms in Mexico.
automations.heroSubtitle: Triggers, rules, and monitoring that handle the repetitive work — so your team focuses on client decisions, not chasing status updates.
automations.infoIntro: We automate the steps your team repeats every day: notifications, data sync, approvals, and escalations — built to survive real-world edge cases.
automations.feature1Desc: A new lead, a paid invoice, a form submission, a calendar event — the workflow starts when <highlight>something actually happens</highlight>, not on a fixed schedule alone.
automations.feature2Desc: If/then logic, routing rules, SLA timers, and exception handling defined with your team — not buried in code nobody can <highlight>read or change</highlight>.
automations.feature3Desc: When something fails or stalls, someone knows. Dashboards and alerts so automations don't become <highlight>silent black boxes</highlight>.
automations.deliverable1: Documented workflow with trigger points and rules
automations.deliverable2: Automation running in production on one process
automations.deliverable3: Error handling, retries, and alert configuration
automations.deliverable4: Runbook for your team to operate and extend the flow
automations.idealForDesc: The same 15 steps happen every week — same copy-paste, same Slack ping, same spreadsheet update — and nobody has time to fix it properly.
automations.ctaHeadline: Which workflow eats the most hours?
automations.ctaText: Describe the repetitive process. We'll map what can be automated first and what still needs a human in the loop.

integrations.metaDescription: Connect CRM, ERP, spreadsheets, email, WhatsApp, and billing so information flows without friction between the tools your firm already uses.
integrations.heroSubtitle: We connect what you already use — CRM, ERP, email, WhatsApp, spreadsheets, billing — so data moves once and everyone works from the same source.
integrations.infoIntro: We don't sell you a new platform. We build the pipes between your existing systems so information flows where it needs to go, in the format each tool expects.
integrations.feature1Desc: Changes in one system reflect in the others — client data, project status, invoices. No more <highlight>which spreadsheet is the latest?</highlight>
integrations.feature2Desc: Native integrations where they exist, custom connectors where they don't. We handle auth, rate limits, and <highlight>retry logic</highlight> so syncs don't break silently.
integrations.feature3Title: WhatsApp and email in the loop
integrations.feature3Desc: Client conversations tied to CRM records. Inbound messages create tasks, update statuses, and notify the right person — <highlight>without manual forwarding</highlight>.
integrations.deliverable1: Integration architecture mapped to your current stack
integrations.deliverable2: Live connectors between your priority systems
integrations.deliverable3: Data mapping documentation and conflict rules
integrations.deliverable4: Monitoring for sync health and failure alerts
integrations.idealForDesc: Your team is the glue between systems — exporting CSVs, re-typing client data, and forwarding WhatsApp messages to the right person.
integrations.timelineNote: First integration path live: typically 3–6 weeks depending on systems.
integrations.ctaText: Tell us where data gets stuck between tools. We'll propose the smallest integration that removes the most friction.

webPages.metaDescription: Landing pages, internal portals, and client-facing sites built to support real business processes — not just to exist on their own.
webPages.heroSubtitle: Landing pages, client portals, and internal tools designed to capture data, trigger workflows, and connect to the systems your operation already runs on.
webPages.infoHeadline: Pages with a job to do
webPages.infoIntro: Every page we build has a purpose in your operation: capture a lead, onboard a client, submit a request, or give your team a dashboard — wired to your backend from day one.
webPages.feature1Desc: Fast, clear, mobile-ready pages that explain your offer and connect to your CRM or contact flow — with <highlight>tracking you can actually use</highlight>.
webPages.feature2Desc: Secure spaces where clients upload documents, check status, or submit requests — and your team sees everything <highlight>without digging through email</highlight>.
webPages.feature3Desc: Submissions that create records, notify the right person, and start automations — not forms that sit in an inbox <highlight>waiting to be processed</highlight>.
webPages.deliverable1: Responsive page or portal designed to your brand
webPages.deliverable2: Form flows connected to your CRM, email, or automations
webPages.deliverable3: SEO basics, analytics, and performance optimization
webPages.deliverable4: CMS or admin access if your team needs to update content
webPages.idealForDesc: You need a professional web presence that does more than look good — it captures leads, collects client input, or gives your team a single place to work.
webPages.timelineNote: Landing page or portal MVP: typically 3–5 weeks.
webPages.ctaHeadline: What should this page do for your operation?
webPages.ctaText: Tell us the job the site needs to perform. We'll scope something useful — not a brochure nobody visits.

apps.metaDescription: Custom web and mobile applications when your workflow needs its own interface — designed to plug into your existing stack and data.
apps.heroSubtitle: Web and mobile applications built for workflows that need their own interface — connected to your data, your permissions, and the tools you already use.
apps.infoIntro: When a process outgrows spreadsheets and email threads, we build the app your team or clients actually need — without replacing everything else you rely on.
apps.feature1Desc: Browser-based tools that work on desktop and mobile — dashboards, request trackers, approval flows — with <highlight>no app store required</highlight> when a PWA fits.
apps.feature2Desc: Camera, offline access, push notifications — we build iOS and Android apps when the workflow <highlight>genuinely needs native capabilities</highlight>.
apps.feature3Desc: Every app reads and writes to your existing systems. Auth, data, and notifications flow through the same <highlight>integrations and agents</highlight> as the rest of your operation.
apps.deliverable1: UX flow and prototype aligned with your process
apps.deliverable2: Production app with auth, roles, and core features
apps.deliverable3: API connections to your CRM, billing, or internal tools
apps.idealForDesc: A workflow has outgrown spreadsheets — too many versions, too many permissions issues, too many steps that only make sense in a dedicated interface.
apps.timelineNote: App MVP on one core workflow: typically 6–10 weeks.
apps.ctaHeadline: Which workflow needs its own app?
apps.ctaText: Describe what your team or clients struggle to do today. We'll tell you if an app is warranted — or if a simpler fix gets you there faster.

consulting.metaDescription: Process mapping, automation prioritization, and a practical roadmap that delivers value in weeks — not a six-month strategy deck.
consulting.heroSubtitle: We map how your operation actually works, identify what to automate first, and define a roadmap you can execute — with honest answers about what isn't worth it yet.
consulting.infoIntro: Consulting with us means working sessions, process maps, and a prioritized plan — not a 40-page report that sits in a folder. You leave knowing exactly what to do next.
consulting.feature1Desc: We walk through the real workflow with the people who run it — systems touched, handoffs, bottlenecks, and the steps <highlight>nobody documented</highlight>.
consulting.feature2Desc: Not everything should be automated first. We rank opportunities by impact, feasibility, and dependency — so you <highlight>start where it hurts most</highlight>.
consulting.feature3Desc: Phases, timelines, and expected outcomes for each initiative. Built to deliver value in weeks, with clear <highlight>go/no-go criteria</highlight> at each stage.
consulting.deliverable1: Current-state process map for your priority workflow
consulting.deliverable2: Ranked list of automation and integration opportunities
consulting.deliverable3: Phased roadmap with timelines and success metrics
consulting.deliverable4: Executive summary your team can act on immediately
consulting.idealForDesc: You know something is broken but aren't sure where to start — or you've been burned by a big project that delivered slides instead of results.
consulting.ctaHeadline: Not sure what to automate first?
consulting.ctaText: Book a free assessment. We'll map one process with you and tell you frankly what's worth building — and what isn't.

training.metaDescription: Hands-on training so your team understands new workflows, tools, and AI agents — and can operate them confidently from day one.
training.heroSubtitle: Practical workshops and documentation so the people who run your processes understand the new tools, agents, and workflows — not just the engineers who built them.
training.infoIntro: Technology only works if the team using it trusts it. We train the people who will operate, monitor, and extend what we build — in their language, on their schedule.
training.feature1Desc: Live sessions where your team runs the new workflow end-to-end — submitting requests, approving steps, reading logs — with <highlight>real scenarios from your operation</highlight>.
training.feature2Desc: Guides written for operators, not developers. What to do when something fails, how to escalate, and where to <highlight>find what you need</highlight> without calling us.
training.feature3Desc: A defined period where your team can ask questions as they adopt the new process. We answer, adjust docs, and fix <highlight>confusion before it becomes resistance</highlight>.
training.deliverable1: Custom workshop agenda based on your new workflow
training.deliverable2: Live training session(s) for operators and admins
training.deliverable4: Support window for questions during adoption
training.idealForDesc: You're launching a new agent, automation, or portal — and need the team that didn't build it to run it confidently without constant external support.
training.timelineNote: Training package: typically delivered in the week of go-live.
training.ctaHeadline: Launching something your team needs to run?
training.ctaText: Tell us what's going live and who's operating it. We'll design training that matches how your team actually works.

privacyPage.label: Legal
privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This policy describes how Breakaway AI ("Breakaway", "we") handles personal data on our website and in the WhatsApp assistants we operate. By using these services, you agree to this policy.
privacyPage.whoBody: Breakaway AI builds and operates AI agents for companies. Contact: general@breakaway.work.
privacyPage.scopeBody: This policy covers the breakaway.work website (or the domain where this page is published), our contact form, and our WhatsApp Business / WhatsApp Cloud API channels, including the assistant that answers queries (for example, weather) and conversations our team may view or continue in the WhatsApp Business app.
privacyPage.dataBody:
Website and form: name, company (optional), WhatsApp, and the message you send us.

WhatsApp: phone number, message content (text and, if sent, files or media), technical IDs Meta sends with the webhook (such as message IDs), and, if you ask for weather, the city you name.

We do not ask for passwords, payment cards, or government IDs for these services.
privacyPage.purposeBody: To respond to your commercial inquiry, operate the chat, generate an automatic reply, let Breakaway staff read and continue the conversation, and keep the service running. The bases are providing the service you request by contacting us, and our legitimate interest in operating sales and support.
privacyPage.whatsappBody: Messages travel on WhatsApp. Meta processes them under their own terms. We receive them via the WhatsApp Cloud API. See WhatsApp's privacy policy (whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy) and Meta's (facebook.com/privacy/policy).
privacyPage.aiBody: Automatic replies may be generated by a language model through our infrastructure (for example Vercel AI Gateway). Message text is sent to that model to produce an answer. We do not sell chats or use them to train public models beyond what those providers state in their own policies.
privacyPage.sharingBody: We do not sell personal data or use it for third-party ads. We share it only with Meta/WhatsApp (the channel), hosting, email, and AI providers needed to run the service, and Breakaway staff who handle the inbox. The contact form is processed with our email provider (Resend) to notify us and, where applicable, record you as a lead.
privacyPage.retentionBody: We keep data as long as needed to handle the conversation or commercial request and for a reasonable support or audit period, unless the law requires longer. We then delete or anonymize it.
privacyPage.rightsBody:
You may request access or deletion by emailing general@breakaway.work and including your email or WhatsApp number. We will delete what we store about that chat or lead, except what we must keep by law. Deleting the thread on your phone does not automatically delete our server copy.

This page also serves as user data deletion instructions for Meta App Review.
privacyPage.childrenBody: These services are not directed at children under 13 (or the minimum age required in your country).
privacyPage.changesBody: We may update this policy. The date at the top shows the current version.
